detail.longDescription: I'm using Vue 3 with TypeScript and Element Plus to render a dynamic form. In view mode, fields are displayed as text. In edit mode, they are replaced with el-select components using v-if / v-else . When switching to edit mode, there's a noticeable delay before the selects appear. All data is already loaded, so this is a rendering issue, not an HTTP request issue. Simplified example: Using v-show would avoid remounting the selects, but it would also mount every select during the initial page load. How can I defer mounting these selects until after the initial render, while keeping them ready for a fast transition to edit mode?
